posts.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
posts.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model, with Lean proof formalizations and research details shared on GitHub.

posts.title: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
posts.summary: OpenAI revealed solutions to long-standing math problems produced by an unreleased frontier model, in 722 manuscripts covering 372 result families, a run that has impressed and unsettled parts of the math world.

posts.title: OpenAI Dumps 377 New Math Results on GitHub, Publishes Hand-Wringing Blog Post
posts.summary: Gizmodo looks at OpenAI's latest bulk release of math results on GitHub and what it means for professional mathematicians.

posts.title: You can now open Claude directly in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides (and vice versa)
posts.summary: Anthropic's Claude can now be opened directly inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, and Claude can open and edit those Workspace files in turn.

posts.title: Atlassian lays groundwork for humans and AI agents to work side by side
posts.summary: At Team '26 Europe, Atlassian announced Agentic Multiplayer Protocol, a platform update for humans and AI agents to collaborate on shared context and tasks in the same workspace.

posts.title: Meta teams up with Bret Taylor’s Sierra Technologies on new standards for AI agent commerce
posts.summary: Meta is partnering with Walmart, Stripe and Sierra on new standards defining how autonomous AI agents interact with businesses online, introduced by Sierra co-founder Bret Taylor.

posts.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
posts.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

posts.title: France's Mistral launches AI model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals
posts.summary: Reuters reports Mistral's CEO says the company's new AI model beats Chinese rivals in some areas.

posts.title: Anthropic opens its most powerful AI models to more security teams
posts.summary: Reuters reports Anthropic is widening access to its most powerful AI models for more security teams.

posts.title: Anthropic folds Project Glasswing into an expanded three-tier Cyber Verification Program
posts.summary: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers of access for vetted security teams, with fewer cybersecurity blocks at each step up.

posts.title: Companies cutting jobs as investments shift toward AI
posts.summary: Reuters tracks companies announcing job cuts as spending shifts toward artificial intelligence.

posts.title: HSBC plans job cuts across UK wealth business in AI push, FT reports
posts.summary: Reuters, citing the Financial Times, reports HSBC plans job cuts across its UK wealth business as part of an AI push.

posts.title: South Korean megachurches probe suspected AI-linked cyberattacks
posts.summary: Reuters reports South Korean megachurches are investigating suspected cyberattacks linked to AI.

posts.title: US Justice Dept tells staff to call AI 'super intelligence' under Trump order
posts.summary: Reuters reports the US Justice Department has told staff to refer to AI as 'super intelligence' under a Trump order.

posts.title: SpaceX seeks $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips, FT reports
posts.summary: Reuters, citing the Financial Times, reports SpaceX is seeking $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips.

posts.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
posts.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

posts.title: TwelveLabs debuts Pegasus 1.6 to improve robotics training data from first-person video
posts.summary: TwelveLabs released Pegasus 1.6, a video-understanding model aimed at turning first-person video into better robotics training data.

posts.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
posts.summary: Google DeepMind introduces EmbeddingGemma 2, an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model that Google says outperforms rival embedding models twice its size.

posts.title: Google's new image model Nano Banana 2.1 generates better images for less money
posts.summary: Google's new Nano Banana 2.1 image model produces better images at a lower price, THE DECODER reports.

posts.title: Court Finds That Using Copyrighted Material as AI Training Data Is Not Fair Use
posts.summary: Futurism covers a court finding that using copyrighted material as AI training data is not fair use, a potential turning point for copyright holders.

rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @financialjuice cites source on Nvidia investing up to $10B in Anthropic IPO — still unverified. oEmbed re-verified evening 7 Oct (HTTP 200).

rumors.summary: UNCONFIRMED X chatter: @wallstengine says Mira Murati's Thinking Machines in talks for $1B+ at ~$40B (Accel/Nvidia interest per TI) — rumor only. oEmbed re-verified evening 7 Oct (HTTP 200).
